messages:
Alex: Heads up — starting a thread to align on long-horizon routing policy + multi-region / multi-tenant tradeoffs. Need launch criteria for 'Regional Routing 2.0' by EOD Fri.

Priya: Love this. Quick ask: which customers are pushing for strict region pinning vs soft affinity? cc @Sam

Sam: FWIW, notes from customer calls — FinanceCorp wants hard residency; Search team customers prefer soft affinity with lower latency. I'll share the prioritized list after this meeting.

Jo: Suggest we define three launch lanes: pilot (1-2 anchor customers on dedicated slices), default (soft-affinity routing), and migration (opt-in tooling and data cutover helpers).

Kai: We should be explicit about metrics. Proposed: p99 tail latency, cross-region hop rate, and cost delta per 1M tokens. Need numeric thresholds so PM can write acceptance criteria.

Alex: Proposed launch criteria draft: p99 <= 250ms for regional routed requests under normal load, failover detection and fallback < 2s, automatic fallback to global routing if regional capacity < 20%. SLA addendum for Dedicated tenants.

Priya: Operational requirements: full telemetry for route decisions, per-tenant heatmaps of region affinity, SLO alerts when routing flip rate > 10/s for a tenant, and retention controls for routing logs (KMS-integrated).

Sam: Customer asks prioritized by ARR/urgency: 1) FinanceCorp (hard residency, blocking), 2) EduCloud (soft affinity + residency preference), 3) AdPartner (high throughput, willing to be soft-affinity).

Jo: Migration path thoughts: offer a 'dry-run' mode for customers (no traffic moved, just metrics), a staged opt-in migration with canaries, and an eviction policy to move low-priority tenants during surge.

Kai: Implementation notes: extend current policy DSL with a regional_preference flag. Route selection hooks into capacity estimator and scoring. Example snippet to discuss: `policy { prefer(region="us-east-1", hard=false, weight=0.8) }`

infra-bot: deploy 2030456849: feature/route-dsl -> staging succeeded :white_check_mark:

Alex: Next steps: Priya to draft launch checklist (perf targets, telemetry, privacy), Sam to validate customer contracts and migration opt-ins, Jo + infra to prototype canary policy and rollback automation. Sync Thurs 10am.

Priya: :thumbsup: I'll include acceptance tests: perf harness + integration test for failover and cost delta measurements.

Alex: Also need to surface unit cost impact in the PRD (per-token cost delta, ops overhead). If no objections I'll create epics and push to the PM board today.

Jo: No objections from me. Want a short runbook for ops: how to quarantine a tenant and how to force global routing for debugging.

Sam: I'll add the customer migration timelines and legal constraints to the doc.

Kai: I'll prototype the scoring changes and a simple sim to estimate tail risk from cross-region hops.

Alex: Good. We'll capture decisions in the roadmap doc and include acceptance tests + a rollback playbook. Thanks everyone.
